# Ordinary Reentry

## User Persona
Maintainer or operator debugging a concrete Local Dream boundary.

## Scenario Coverage
Source-informed lifecycle intermediate case; prompt in `user_request.txt`. Expected owner files are in `assertions.json`. No original upstream test spans this scenario, so this is synthetic.

## Expected Successful Behavior
- Recognize the source stop grace and equal full-config reuse.
- Separate ProcessBuilder start and Running from native health/readiness.
- Do not diagnose a leak or native PASS from process survival.

## Failure Signals
Generic advice without the specified source distinction, source-checkout runtime dependence, copied private paths, unsafe host exposure, license erasure or synthetic/native evidence conflation.
